evo.methode_1: Each question follows the FSRS-6 spaced-repetition model, tuned for 90% recall: it estimates your chance of remembering each question, every day. “Retained” is the average of those chances over the questions you have seen; the figure at the top relates it to the whole course (a question never seen counts as 0).
evo.methode_2: Your confidence before the correction sets the grade: sure and right = good, unsure = hard, guessing or wrong = to review.
